subject: Competitive evaluation: packaging & value-match for Platinum AI
messages:
From: Alex Li <alex@platinum.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-18T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Evaluating Redwood as replacement — packaging & price details

Hi Sofia,

Quick intro — I’m Alex (Head of Cloud Procurement) at Platinum AI. We’re running a replacement evaluation for our current inference provider (NimbusCore) and Redwood was recommended by our ML infra team. Before we jump into a call, can you share: current packaging (seat vs. consumption), typical commit tiers, and any migration/onboarding credits you offer for a 12–24 month commit?

High level context: 20M tokens/month, 4 dedicated LLM routes (chat/generation/embeddings/rerank), strict SOC2 + EU data residency requirements for one of our products. Our procurement team will need a line-item comparison to present to finance.

If possible, please attach a simple side-by-side econ sheet — we’ll share NimbusCore’s numbers on our side.

Thanks — happy to get a 30m call on Mon or Tue.

Alex Li
Head of Cloud Procurement | Platinum AI
procurement@platinum.ai
phone: +1 415-555-0192

Attachments referenced: none
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Alex Li <alex@platinum.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-18T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluating Redwood as replacement — packaging & price details

Hi Alex — great to meet you over email.

We can definitely put together a concise comparison. Quick answers up front:
- Packaging: we support pure consumption billing, committed monthly/annual spend (reserved capacity) and hybrid bundles (committed + burst).
- Commit tiers typically start at $20k/mo for the smallest reserved pool and scale with discounts at $50k/mo, $150k/mo, and $500k+/mo.
- Pilot/migration credits: we commonly provide a 4–8 week pilot credit (token/seat neutral) and a one-time onboarding credit tied to the size of the commit — we will propose specifics after we see your NimbusCore terms.

I attached a short template we usually use; can you send NimbusCore’s pricing? If not, rough ballpark top-level numbers are fine. I’ve CC’d Marcus (pricing) and Sean (solutions) who will join the call.

I’m available Mon 10/18 4:00–5:30pm PT or Tue 10/19 9:00–11:00am PT for a short sync — which works for you?

Best,
Sofia
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-econ-template.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-19T11:26:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Platinum AI — initial pricing options

Sofia / Sean — internal note before we craft the official sheet for Alex.

Context: Platinum is mid-market with scale potential. They list 20M tokens/mo (estimate) and have an EU residency requirement for one product. NimbusCore likely has a headline discount + an on-prem/data residency surcharge.

Suggested first-pass offer (to present):
- 12 month committed spend @ $50k/mo -> 18% discount vs our list; include 6 weeks pilot credit = $8k equivalent.
- Add-on: EU-residency node + private VPC packaging -> $4k/mo premium (or provide a partial credit for first 3 months).
- Migration/Onboarding: free technical onboarding (2 engineers x 4 weeks) + $12k migration credit to offset egress or custom connectors.

If they push back on headline discount, we can structure a 6-month ramp with a higher credit and smaller discount initially. Also consider offering a 3-month price-protection clause if they go multi-year.

Attachments: none
From: Alex Li <alex@platinum.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@platinum.ai
Date: 2027-10-20T14:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluating Redwood as replacement — packaging & price details

Sofia — thanks for the rapid reply. Tuesday 10/19 9:30am PT works for the team, we’ve booked a short sync.

A few clarifying notes from procurement after a quick look:
- NimbusCore is currently at $42k/mo committed for their reserved pool with an additional $3k/mo for EU-residency; they offered a one-time $15k onboarding credit and a 10% overage cap for the first 6 months.
- We need to see an explicit line-item comparison (list price, committed discount, onboarding credit, EU surcharge, SLA language for latency/uptime, and data residency controls).
- Pricing authority: finance will not approve >18% discount without VP level sign-off. We can accept a higher total value via credits but prefer discount on recurring if possible.

Can Redwood provide a PDF term sheet and a simple XLS comparison we can include in our procurement packet? Also confirm SOC2 attestations (we’ll need an AICPA report or link).

Thanks — Alex

Subject: Re: Evaluating Redwood as replacement — packaging & price details

Alex — appreciate the context and the Nimbus numbers. Attached are two files: a one-page XLS with a line-by-line econ comparison and a draft term sheet PDF for procurement. High-level offer summary below to make life easier for finance: 

Offer summary (12-mo commit):
- Committed spend: $50,000 / month (12 months) — recurring discount 18% off list.
- Onboarding/migration: $12,000 one-time credit + 6-week pilot credit (token-neutral).
- EU data-residency node: $3,000 / month add-on; waive first 2 months of the EU surcharge as a migration concession.
- SLA: 99.9% uptime, 95th percentile token latency target included in Appendix A of the term sheet.
- Price protection: 6 months guaranteed at the committed rate; annual repricing thereafter.

We’ve positioned the discount at 18% to be within typical finance approval thresholds. If you need a deeper concession (e.g., 22–25%), we’ll need VP approval and would ask for a 24-month commit or a higher starting band.

Next steps:
1) Review attached XLS + draft term sheet and confirm redlines from procurement.
2) If acceptable, sign and we’ll schedule the onboarding kickoff (dates in the draft).
3) Technical prework: Sean will reach out to set up a short architectural review for EU-residency config.

Attachments: redwood-proposal-vs-nimbuscore.xlsx (xlsx); redwood-draft-term-sheet.pdf (pdf)

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.com
Phone: +1 510-555-0123
